structured.answer: From the page I worked out there are two parts: where the money sits (עו"ש, פיקדון, קרן השתלמות, קופת גמל להשקעה, חשבון ניירות ערך) and what it's invested in (קרן כספית, מק"מ, S&P 500 and so on). For me that means looking at the קרן השתלמות I already have, a חשבון ניירות ערך for the S&P 500, and a קרן כספית for money I need to be able to get at. It doesn't tell me fees or which one to choose, so I'd tap the S&P 500 card next.
